title: Buzz Blitz — Cat vs Bees
short_desc: One-tap dodge action! Guide a brave cat past a swarm of angry bees, climb levels, chain combos and set new records. Free hyper-casual fun.
how_to_play: Tap left/right or use Arrow keys to change lanes. Dodge incoming bees, collect golden fish, grab Shields & Magnets, and trigger invincible Fever Mode!
